title: From Highscope to UW: How I Skipped Two Years and Found My Path
preview: My journey from being a high school student in Jakarta who played games all day, to studying abroad alone at 15, to now being a junior at the University of Washington. A story about independence, taking chances, and finding my path in tech.

title: BC Hacks 2024 Lecture
preview: After helping organize and launch BC Hacks 2024, I was invited to give a lecture at Bellevue College about how to run a successful hackathon. This session was specially arranged for a group of 20+ Korean exchange students visiting from Korea.
